subject: general
question: Non-functional dimensions are ____________________.

options.text: essential to the function of the location or component
derived from the values ​​of the corresponding attributes of the drawing
not essential to the function of the space or component
derived directly from the values ​​given on the drawing

solution:
__**Explanation:**__

**Non-functional Dimensions**

**Definition:** Non-functional dimensions in the context of engineering design are dimensions that are not critical to the functional operation of a component or space. These dimensions often provide additional descriptive or reference information but do not directly influence the functionality or performance of the part or assembly.

**Key Characteristics of Non-functional Dimensions:**

 
• They serve as reference dimensions or supplementary information to provide a clearer understanding of the design.
 
• These dimensions are not essential for the functionality of the component or system being designed.
